svg.aria-label: Sketch after an AFP/Getty photograph on ABC News: the North Portico of the White House at dusk on Thursday evening, four columns under the entablature, the door open on a lit interior beneath its fanlight, the red carpet running up the steps toward it, and four Marine honor guards saluting on the steps as contour figures with no facial detail. The two presidents and their wives who posed on the steps are not drawn.
